verdicts.reason: A keeps the 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' headline large, so it still clearly leads the design. However, the decoration clusters are pushed out to the edges, leaving big empty yellow bands on either side of the SALE lanterns. Those bands look like the original was simply widened, not rearranged. B has the same widened layout but shrinks the headline, which weakens the hierarchy. It also squeezes the lanterns and clouds into tighter side clusters with uneven dead space, so the SALE column looks undersized for the wider banner.
